title: Enforce code-owner review in branch protection and set codeownersEnforced in the SDLC policy
description: Turn on 'Require review from Code Owners' (required_pull_request_reviews.require_code_owner_reviews true) in the branch protection rule or ruleset for OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server main and OnFinance/onfinance_db_model_master master. Keep the existing required approvals at 1 or more, and keep blocking self-approval. Also turn on 'Include administrators' so the CODEOWNERS file cannot be bypassed. Then change company-profile/example-co/sdlc/policy.json so codeReview.codeownersEnforced is true, as a human-reviewed edit with provenance harness human; the policy owner role is cto. Constraint: switch enforcement on only after tasks 2 and 3 have merged and the task 1 teams have at least two members each, so no open PR is stranded. Tell the engineering teams before switching; no deployment window applies.

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-sdlc for example-co. Expected: the code-review check reads policy.json codeReview.codeownersEnforced true, finds code-owner review required on both default branches, and fingerprint 483d900fc78892034ce3461af56d9a9c81fe97b2438bbdc85a5fca7cad8c583c is not produced.

rootCause.description: The SDLC policy requires one approver but never required that approver to be the accountable owner. Branch protection was set up to match that policy, so even a correct CODEOWNERS file would only be advisory.
